use: Precisely infuse or withdraw liquid by set volume / rate, adding through tubing.
simulation: Syringe capacity, plunger position and switching valve (Cavro) are all modeled; pushing empty / drawing dry raises an alarm.
notes: Reference model profile: syringe pump (used as a titration dispenser)
Spec values not individually verified (verified = false).
sources: NE-1000 user manual (includes RS232 command set; to be archived and checked)

spec.notes: Flow range depends on syringe inner diameter

to_calibrate: Actual dispensed volume vs setpoint (weigh on a balance)

comms.notes: Example commands DIA / RAT / VOL / DIR INF / RUN / STP; the manual is authoritative

dispense.description: Refill as needed + dispense: if the syringe holds too little, switch the valve to in and draw the shortfall, then switch back to out and push volume at rate

infuse.description: Push only the liquid already in the syringe to the out port; alarms and stops when empty

withdraw.description: Withdraw into the syringe from port (in or out, default out)

refill.description: Switch the valve to in, fill the syringe (or draw volume), then switch back to out

pause.description: Pause the current action (keeps the remaining volume)

stop.description: Stop and discard the remaining action
